"""Follow-up after observed coordinate/date boundary degradation. Real visual clock labels only."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,copy,math,sys
import cv2,numpy as np,yaml,paddle
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent;V3=PARENT/'paired-v3'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda n,o:(ROOT/n).write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
m=read(V3/'paired-manifest.json');rows={r['id']:r for r in m['rows']}
seconds={744:21,745:21,746:22,747:22,748:23,749:23,750:24,751:24,752:25,753:25,
    884:35,885:35,886:36,887:36,888:37,889:37,890:38,891:38,892:39,893:39,894:40,895:40,896:41,897:41,898:42,899:42,900:43}
labels=[];images={};inputs={i['sourceId']:i for i in read(V3/'supplement-inputs.json')['inputs']}
(ROOT/'context-images').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
for ident,item in inputs.items():
    n=int(ident[-6:]);r=rows[ident];assert r['split']=='train' and n in seconds
    clock=f"2026-10-14 14:{10 if n<800 else 11:02d}:{seconds[n]:02d}+8"
    text=r['text']+' '+clock
    assert len(text)<48 and set(text)<=set('0123456789-,+: ')
    labels.append({'id':ident,'coordinateText':r['text'],'clockText':clock,'text':text,
        'origin':'Assistant visual transcription from original timestamp-qa-1/2 contact sheets; no OCR text or interpolated clock used as truth.',
        'humanVerified':False,'sourceImage':r['sourceImage'],'sourceSHA256':r['sourceSHA256']})
    for variant in ['raw','contrast','tophat']:
        path=V3/'native-preprocessed'/f"{item['id']}.{variant}.png"
        pixels=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(path.read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
        # Includes visible XYZ/date/time/+8, stops before '*' and the alphabetic HDR field.
        right=4+math.floor((568-item['rect'][0])*(pixels.shape[1]-8)/item['rect'][2])
        crop=pixels[:,:right];target=ROOT/'context-images'/f'{ident}.{variant}.png';assert cv2.imwrite(str(target),crop)
        images[(ident,variant)]={'image':str(target),'id':ident,'variant':variant,'text':text,
            'sourceNativeImage':str(path),'sourceNativeImageSHA256':sha(path),'sourceNativeRect':[0,0,right,48],
            'imageSHA256':sha(target),'note':'Label-informed training context crop. End-to-end evaluation retains original fixed full ROI.'}
entries=copy.deepcopy(m['trials']['pair-routes']['orderedSamples'][:1728])
for p in m['pairs']:
    for role in ['clearer','obscured']:
        entries.append({**images[(p[role],p['routeVariant'])],'pairRole':role})
assert len(entries)==1984
(ROOT/'context-routes.txt').write_text(''.join(e['image'].replace('\\','/')+'\t'+e['text']+'\n' for e in entries),encoding='utf-8')
c=yaml.safe_load((V3/'pair-routes.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
c['Global'].update(epoch_num=3,max_text_length=48,save_model_dir=str(ROOT/'context-routes').replace('\\','/'),
    save_res_path=str(ROOT/'predictions.txt').replace('\\','/'),eval_batch_step=[0,248],d2s_train_image_shape=[3,48,896])
for h in c['Architecture']['Head']['head_list']:
    if 'NRTRHead' in h:h['NRTRHead']['max_text_length']=48
c['Train']['dataset'].update(data_dir=str(ROOT).replace('\\','/'),label_file_list=[str(ROOT/'context-routes.txt').replace('\\','/')])
c['Train']['loader']['batch_size_per_card']=8
for section in ['Train','Eval']:
    for t in c[section]['dataset']['transforms']:
        if 'RecResizeImg' in t:t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape']=[3,48,896]
(ROOT/'context-routes.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(c,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')
export=copy.deepcopy(c);export['Global'].update(pretrained_model=str(ROOT/'context-routes/latest').replace('\\','/'),
    save_inference_dir=str(ROOT/'context-routes-infer-paddle30').replace('\\','/'),d2s_train_image_shape=[3,48,320])
for t in export['Eval']['dataset']['transforms']:
    if 'RecResizeImg' in t:t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape']=[3,48,320]
(ROOT/'context-routes-export-paddle30.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(export,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')
write('context-manifest.json',{'purpose':'Exploratory context-supervision follow-up, prompted by observed lost/replaced coordinate/date spaces. Not a matched-budget causal comparison to v3.',
    'v3ManifestSHA256':sha(V3/'paired-manifest.json'),'v3ReportSHA256':sha(V3/'paired-report.json'),
    'coordinateLabelsChanged':False,'splitChangedFromV3':False,'humanVerified':False,'clockLabels':labels,
    'images':list(images.values()),'entries':entries,'epochs':3,'batchSize':8,'trainingWidth':896,'maxTextLength':48,
    'evaluationUsesSame319UnlabeledInputsPlus27TrainedFit':True,'newDownloadsBytes':0,
    'limitations':['Only 27 clock/date training contexts from two stationary positions; validation remains explored same-session.',
        'Targets are visible numeric text through +8. Context crops exclude unsupported trailing star/HDR; runtime fixed ROI remains unchanged.',
        'Width, sequence length, batch and update budget changed together; do not attribute results solely to context labels.']})
# Sequence-length changes must not silently randomize or drop pretrained parameters.
sys.path.insert(0,str(PARENT/'PaddleOCR-source'))
from ppocr.modeling.architectures import build_model
from ppocr.postprocess import build_post_process
paddle.set_device('cpu');decoder=build_post_process(c['PostProcess'],c['Global']);arch=copy.deepcopy(c['Architecture']);n=len(decoder.character)
arch['Head']['out_channels_list']={'CTCLabelDecode':n,'SARLabelDecode':n+2,'NRTRLabelDecode':n+3}
model=build_model(arch);weights=paddle.load(str(PARENT/'numeric-runtime-initial.pdparams'))
assert len(model.state_dict())==len(weights)==968
assert all(k in weights and list(v.shape)==list(weights[k].shape) for k,v in model.state_dict().items())
print('Prepared 27 visually transcribed clocks, 81 context images,1984 entries; all968 pretrained parameter shapes preserved.')

"""Native full fixed-ROI replay, retaining v3 cohort and all prior evidence unchanged."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,os,hashlib,subprocess,importlib.util
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;V3=ROOT.parent/'paired-v3'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS');DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py')

output=ROOT/'replay-context-routes.json';assert not output.exists()
before=b.provenance(SOURCE,DATA,V3/'development-corpus.json',native,DATA/'third_party/research/WutheringWaves-Navigator',model)

"""Reuse v3 cohort scorer in-memory, without changing any v3 files or old reports."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;V3=ROOT.parent/'paired-v3'
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
# Extract only the existing pure counting definitions; do not execute its file-writing main body.
source=(V3/'score_pairs.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
definitions=source.split("for model,path in [",1)[0]
namespace={'__file__':str(V3/'score_pairs.py')};exec(compile(definitions,str(V3/'score_pairs.py'),'exec'),namespace)
native=read(ROOT/'replay-context-routes.json')
for mode,values in native['pipelines'].items():namespace['count']('context-routes',mode,values)
old=read(V3/'paired-report.json')
report={**old,'scope':old['scope']+' Context follow-up changes training geometry and text supervision; not a matched-budget comparison.',
    'v3ReportSHA256':sha(V3/'paired-report.json'),'contextManifestSHA256':sha(ROOT/'context-manifest.json'),
    'summary':old['summary']+namespace['summaries'],'wrongCases':old['wrongCases']+namespace['wrong'],
    'sourceEvidence':old['sourceEvidence']+[{'model':'context-routes','path':str(ROOT/'replay-context-routes.json'),'sha256':sha(ROOT/'replay-context-routes.json')}]}
(ROOT/'context-report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for s in namespace['summaries']:
    if s['mode'] in ['ppocr-contrast-clock','ppocr-corroborated-clock']:
        print(s['mode'],s['group'],s['correct'],s['wrong'],s['miss'],'FP',s['falsePositive'],flush=True)

verify_context.py.text:
"""Audit context follow-up independently of its in-memory v3 counter implementation."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,pickle,re,importlib.util
import numpy as np,cv2,paddle,yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent;V3=PARENT/'paired-v3';DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
m=read(ROOT/'context-manifest.json');v3=read(V3/'paired-manifest.json')
assert m['v3ManifestSHA256']==sha(V3/'paired-manifest.json') and m['v3ReportSHA256']==sha(V3/'paired-report.json')
rows={r['id']:r for r in v3['rows']};train={i for i,r in rows.items() if r['split']=='train'};dev={i for i,r in rows.items() if r['split']=='development'}
assert len(train)==740 and len(dev)==170 and not train&dev
assert len(m['entries'])==1984 and {r['id'] for r in m['entries']}==train
assert m['entries'][:1728]==v3['trials']['pair-routes']['orderedSamples'][:1728]
for item in m['clockLabels']:
    assert item['id'] in train and item['coordinateText']==rows[item['id']]['text']
    assert item['text']==item['coordinateText']+' '+item['clockText'] and len(item['text'])<=48
    assert re.fullmatch(r'2026-10-14 14:1[01]:[0-5][0-9]\+8',item['clockText'])
    assert sha(Path(item['sourceImage']))==item['sourceSHA256']
assert len(m['clockLabels'])==27 and len({r['id'] for r in m['clockLabels']})==27
for image in m['images']:
    assert image['id'] in train and image['id'] not in dev
    assert sha(Path(image['image']))==image['imageSHA256'] and sha(Path(image['sourceNativeImage']))==image['sourceNativeImageSHA256']
    a=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(Path(image['sourceNativeImage']).read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    b=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(Path(image['image']).read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    x0,y0,x1,y1=image['sourceNativeRect'];assert np.array_equal(a[y0:y1,x0:x1],b)
lines=(ROOT/'context-routes.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines();assert len(lines)==1984
for line,e in zip(lines,m['entries']):
    path,text=line.split('\t');assert Path(path)==Path(e['image']) and text==e['text'] and e['id'] not in dev
state=pickle.loads((ROOT/'context-routes/latest.states').read_bytes());assert state['epoch']==3 and state['global_step']==741
paddle.set_device('cpu');before=paddle.load(str(PARENT/'numeric-runtime-initial.pdparams'));after=paddle.load(str(ROOT/'context-routes/latest.pdparams'))
assert len(after)==968 and set(after)==set(before) and all(np.isfinite(x.numpy()).all() for x in after.values())
bn=[k for k in after if k.endswith(('._mean','._variance'))];assert len(bn)==302
assert all(np.array_equal(before[k].numpy(),after[k].numpy()) for k in bn)
changed=sum(not np.array_equal(before[k].numpy(),after[k].numpy()) for k in after if k not in bn)
log=(ROOT/'context-train.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
assert not re.search(r'\bloss:\s*(?:nan|inf)\b',log,re.I)
assert 'not matched with loaded params' not in log and 'not in model' not in log
folder=ROOT/'context-routes-infer-paddle30';meta=yaml.safe_load((folder/'inference.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(meta['PostProcess']['character_dict'])==14 and meta['PostProcess']['character_dict']==(folder/'ppocr_keys.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
assert [t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape'] for t in meta['PreProcess']['transform_ops'] if 'RecResizeImg' in t]==[[3,48,320]]
assert read(folder/'inference.json')['base_code']['version']==1
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py');b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
raw=read(ROOT/'replay-context-routes.json');prov=read(ROOT/'replay-context-provenance.json');b.verify_native_provenance(prov,raw['metadata'])
report=read(ROOT/'context-report.json');summary={(s['mode'],s['group']):s for s in report['summary'] if s['model']=='context-routes'}
development=read(V3/'development-corpus.json');fit=read(V3/'training-pair-corpus.json')
frames={f['id']:f for f in development['frames']+fit['frames']};inputs=read(V3/'replay-inputs.json')['inputs'];index={i['id']:i for i in inputs}
groups=[('all-development',{f['id'] for f in development['frames']}),('trained-pairs-fit-only',{f['id'] for f in fit['frames']}),
    ('heldout-stationary-776-787',{i for i in dev if 776<=int(i[-6:])<=787})]
groups += [(g,{i for i in dev if rows[i]['sceneGroup']==g}) for g in {rows[i]['sceneGroup'] for i in dev}]
verified=0
for mode,values in raw['pipelines'].items():
    assert len(values)==346 and {r['id'] for r in values}==set(index)
    for p in values:assert p['pixelDigest']==index[p['id']]['pixelDigest']
    for group,ids in groups:
        pp=[p for p in values if p['id'].split('@')[0] in ids];ii=[i for i in inputs if i['sourceId'] in ids]
        cc={'frames':[f for ident,f in frames.items() if ident in ids]};_,scored=b.summarize(cc,ii,{mode:pp});s=summary[(mode,group)]
        assert s['correct']==sum(x['exactXYZ'] is True for x in scored)
        assert s['wrong']==sum(x['wrongXYZReturn'] is True for x in scored)
        assert s['miss']==sum(x['abstained'] and x['state']=='present' for x in scored)
        assert s['falsePositive']==sum(x['falsePositive'] is True for x in scored)
    verified+=len(values)
historical_folder=ROOT/'historical-context';h=read(historical_folder/'report.json');hr=read(historical_folder/'ppocr.json')
b.verify_native_provenance(h['provenance'],hr['metadata']);assert h['repeats']==3 and h['sourceFrameIds']==11
hc=read(PARENT/'coverage-v2/historical-evaluation-corpus.json')
ss,scored=b.summarize(hc,read(historical_folder/'inputs.json')['inputs'],hr['pipelines'])
for path,d in read(DATA/'out/coordinate-label-expansion-20261015/verification.json')['sourceHashes'].items():assert sha(Path(path))==d
result={'epochs':3,'optimizerUpdates':741,'imagePresentations':5928,'trainingUniqueSources':740,'newClockTranscriptions':27,
    'verifiedContextCrops':81,'finiteParameterEntries':968,'unchangedBNBuffers':302,'changedOtherEntries':changed,
    'independentlyScoredFrameJudgments':verified,'noPartitionLeakage':True,'coordinateLabelsUnchanged':True,
    'independentAcceptance':False,'productionChanged':False,'newDownloadsBytes':0,'reportSHA256':sha(ROOT/'context-report.json'),
    'weightsSHA256':sha(ROOT/'context-routes/latest.pdparams'),'inferenceFiles':{n:sha(folder/n) for n in ['inference.json','inference.pdiparams','inference.yml','ppocr_keys.txt']},
    'historicalSummary':[s for s in ss if s['profile']=='readout-line' and s['mode'] in ['ppocr-contrast-clock','ppocr-corroborated-clock']],
    'historicalHardCases':[{k:x.get(k) for k in ['id','mode','selected','rawText','expected','state','exactXY','exactXYZ']} for x in scored
        if x['id'] in ['user-grass@readout-line','user-snow@readout-line'] and x['mode'] in ['ppocr-contrast-clock','ppocr-corroborated-clock']],
    'environmentWarning':'GPU cuDNN compile9.9/available9.5 warning retained; final replay uses existing CPU native library.'}
(ROOT/'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
